snippet.description:
This road is not an ending place
Where time begins and fades away
Where every step you leave behind
Still finds a way to stay

Lay your worries down right here
They won’t follow where you go
What remains is something else
A quiet, distant glow

All the things you couldn’t hold
Are still somehow right here

This road is not an ending now
It’s where everything aligns
Where worries fade into the air
And memories intertwine
